superseded.reason: Not released; superseded by c831245, which has the same code (the only later change is the planning workbook, an evidence file). Eight checks passed here: CI Tier 1, linked reports, README fresh, offline reproduction, fresh clone verify, demo rebuilt, own key real and no-key paths. live_site_external was not run: a workbook commit had been pushed to main after this candidate was cut, so the check refused to dispatch a run that would have tested another commit. The Tier 2 attempt (release-ef4dfbb807b7 in evidence/release-gate-ledger.json) was started at 17:31 UTC and stopped about two minutes later on purpose, before any pair finished, because a result for this candidate could not count for the next one; its outcome stays empty. From here no commit is pushed to main between cutting a candidate and its external check.
